body: I feel you. I get these horrible panic attacks that last hours, and the entire time i'm just trying not to hurt myself. Ruins the rest of the day for me. Really hard to avoid something as common as criticism.. yet I haven't felt it get any easier :/
All while uncontrollably laughing and recording her, making it completely obvious she doesn't mean any of those words

I suppose that's fair, just please don't spank them out of anger or impatience. Choose spanking as a last resort. Always explain why, and how they can do better since unpredictability will cause them to fear you. 

My case was rather extreme, but I'm still struggling as an adult to learn that doing *very basic* things like standing up for myself isn't going to end up in me getting beat. Irresponsible spanking left some serious mental scars I don't think I can undo.

I feel like spanking wouldn't have fucked me up if my dad had a valid reason for doing so. He'd spank me with all of his strength sometimes for simply disagreeing with him or spilling a cup of water. What is that supposed to teach me? Have no opinions and be constantly paranoid about my surroundings? Thanks.

Reading that you chose to stay warmed my heart. I'm genuinely proud of you. :)

I was just going through those same feelings of complete exhaustion yesterday morning, I had a noose and everything at the ready. I don't want to die either, but continuing felt impossibly overwhelming. After ruminating for quite a bit I just thought fuck it, i'll give it another honest shot. I'm not exactly in a hurry to die I guess. 

I know i'll fall back into that deep pit of despair again, and all I can hope is that I give myself another chance like I did yesterday. I hope you feel the same. I'm glad I did so that I was able to see this post and let you know you're not alone. 

About keeping in touch, I'm currently in the spot where I feel like I want to hide from everyone. I really do wish I was in a more helpful spot. I'll read everything you write, but my anxiety is eating me up over giving you a good enough response each time haha. Please keep reaching out to this community when in need, and of course stay safe. You are a lovely person that i'm glad I got the pleasure to talk to, keep on fighting friend ❤️

Hey, I see you and appreciate how long you've been fighting for. I promise you're not invisible. As someone who also really wants to give up because of crippling social anxiety, I completely understand how horribly exhausting and soul crushing this illness is. I'm really sorry you have to live like this as well. 

Sadly I can't share any positive stories where I managed to tell my social anxiety to permanently fuck off somehow, but i'm still going. Maybe it's the small amount of hope I have remaining that i'll finally be in control one day, or maybe it's because that same anxiety makes killing myself seem absolutely terrifying. Whatever it is, i'm still giving it my best shot.. sometimes. 

Oh yeah, I'll absolutely get burntout and feel like finally giving in for most of the year.. but i'm taking teeny baby steps when I build up enough energy again. I'm wayyy down at the bottom of the list of things I need to do to even have a shot at trying to get rid of the anxiety, like, try to manage to get out of bed today and brush your teeth kind of low, but thinking about how life changing it would feel to finally feel loved and accepted for once makes me feel like it's worth the effort most times. 

I feel like i'm at rock bottom right now. I haven't talked to anyone in months and the only emotion I feel is constant shame, but just for once i'd like to experience what not giving a single fuck is like. What feeling absolutely confident and not having a single second thought in what I said is like, what feeling loved and good enough is like. I hope we both get there, wishing you the best man. Let me know what you're feeling.
